opening.argument: The video is built around a practical Coinbase walkthrough: funding an account, buying and selling cryptocurrency, withdrawing money, and transferring holdings to an external wallet. It gives concrete instructions for selecting a transfer amount, making a purchase, and finding a destination wallet address. The speaker also warns that people entering crypto may lose money. Coinbase learning rewards and an external quiz-answer site appear within that tutorial, while the description discloses affiliate compensation and referrals. The available evidence does not establish whether any linked service is safe or whether anyone received a reward.
